source.note: Photos and text from kadiak.org (Kodiak Military History Museum site). Text by Joe Stevens.

k_abercrombie_miller_pt_aerial_2001may1.caption: [Miller Point, Fort Abercrombie, aerial, 1 May 2001 (from the file name). Page text: 'This is a World War II Coastal Defense installation with two eight inch guns. The remnants of both guns are on display.']

k_abercrombie_8inch_1943.caption: The eight-inch Mark VI guns were designed as battleship guns for World War I. The photo shows Seabees installing a gun at Miller Point in 1943.

k_abercrombie_aber_fc_tower_.caption: [Fort Abercrombie fire-control tower; the page labels it 1957.]

k_photos_don_warner_don_warner_8.caption: Gun battery emergency command station on top of ready ammo bunker.

k_vfw_pic19.caption: SCR-296 radar building looking east, 1 August 1943 NOB Kodiak (VFW collection)

k_abercrombie_sl21dec1.caption: DEC for S/L 21 seen from S/L 21.

k_abercrombie_burton2.caption: Inside the Quonset hut used as a canteen. A pool table is located behind the group. The white square above their heads is a movie screen. Taken just before the arrival of Stan Musial and group.
k_abercrombie_burton2.credit: Photo from Reuben Burton, Jr. (via kadiak.org)

k_1944annex_41b.caption: [Fort Abercrombie map from the 1944 Harbor Defense Project annex. Page text: 'Google Earth coordinates of the 8-inch gun bunker: 57 50 12N 152 21 12W.']
k_1944annex_41b.credit: Map: 1944 Harbor Defense Project of Kodiak (declassified), via kadiak.org
